name: Super Sour Diesel - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 1g
description:
Rove Ice Packs prerolls, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin, expertly rolled and coated in more ice hash. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 50% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls.

SUPER SOUR DIESEL
A fuel-fired sativa powerhouse with tastes of pungent diesel and tangy citrus, Super Sour Diesel delivers a fast-acting cerebral rush with just enough grounding warmth to keep you sharp, social, and firing on all cylinders.
